newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rallies further on London gains.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rallies further on London gains.

text.p: Malaysian tin price continued its upward trend, rising seven cents to finish at 13.92 ringgit ($5.55) a kg mainly attributed to gains in the London Metal Exchange, traders said.
"London metals firmed further last night. So tin in Kuala Lumpur followed suit," a trader said, adding that demand was seen from overseas again.
"Overseas buyers continued to cover their positions in KLTM as the local price is still below 14 ringgit, despite a high local premium over London," a trader said.
Buyers were from Europe, Japan and locally.
Traders reported an opening bid of 131 tonnes against offer of 69 tonnes. Final turnover was 80 tonnes against 129 on Wednesday.
Traders said the price would rise back to the psychological level of 14 ringgit if demand was sustained and the London market stayed firm.
The local premium over London widened to $100 a tonne from $75 previously.
